children: Overview
U.S. community bank's Q3 net income and EPS rose sharply year-over-year
Net interest income for Q3 increased 11% from a year earlier
Noninterest expense declined, mainly due to lower employee benefits costs
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
Result Drivers
LOWER INTEREST EXPENSE - Co said net interest income growth was mainly due to reduced interest expense, despite weaker investment income
HIGHER FEE INCOME - Co said increased wealth management fees, loan service charges, and bank-owned life insurance contributed to noninterest income growth
LOWER EMPLOYEE BENEFITS COSTS - Co attributed decline in noninterest expense mainly to reduced health insurance costs
